## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refresh path must preserve existing fingerprints before merge because it can make an edited tracked file pass integrity verification.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register unlisted files, with tests for both helpers. Tests were read, not run.

## Critical
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — When you refresh an edited tracked file alongside a new file, this assignment replaces its original digest with the edited content’s hash, causing `verify` to return true. — Refreshing after adding files silently removes the evidence needed to detect edits to tracked files included in the refresh. — Fix: Preserve existing entries as `register_new_files` does, and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries` with an edited tracked file.
